_why: Few-shot examples for sem.py phase 2. Each entry gives the model tweets that
genuinely match a concept, so it writes queries backwards from real text
instead of from the concept name. That is worth more than a better prompt:
the model cannot know that X indexes 'DM me your work' but not 'open roles'
Add your own by pasting tweets you already know are good. The best examples
are the awkward ones: slang, lowercase, missing apostrophes, no role named.
Ten real examples beat fifty invented ones.
This is few-shot prompting. No embeddings and no fine-tuning are involved.
